oracle: CASA and its casacore table reader

ordinary.scope: Six numerical and spectrum-management modes across absent, complete and partly defined spectra. Includes Multi-MS, flagged visibilities and a 122,880-row casacore readback across the native write-batch boundary. Includes refusal of a zero-row MS.

tsys.scope: Both temperature modes with gain-field selection, channel and time interpolation, explicit and relative spectral-window mappings, flagged and invalid temperatures, FLOAT_DATA, and scalar and spectrum outputs. Includes relative paths, single-correlation Stokes I and missing calibration windows.
